title: Deterministic Model Resolution
description: The system shall resolve the execution model according to strict precedence: (1) explicit tool argument, (2) LOCAL_LLM_MODEL environment variable, (3) auto-detected preferred model from Ollama /api/tags, and (4) default fallback 'qwen2.5-coder:14b'.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit argument overrides environment variable and auto-detection.
Non-empty LOCAL_LLM_MODEL overrides auto-detection when no explicit argument is provided.
Auto-detection selects preferred coder model if available.
System falls back to default model if API call fails or no tags exist.

title: Local Code Drafting Execution
description: The system shall format and dispatch code drafting prompts to the local Ollama /api/generate endpoint with a specialized software engineering system prompt, returning generated code strings.
acceptance_criteria: Formats prompt containing language, context, and task description.
Enforces system prompt instructing clean, modular production code.
Returns Ollama response content on HTTP 200.
Returns descriptive error string on connection or HTTP failure.

title: Dense Summarization & Noise Extraction
description: The system shall compress raw text, logs, or traces into high-density technical summaries matching a specified extraction goal using temperature <= 0.2.
acceptance_criteria: Constructs extraction prompt containing target goal and content.
Instructs model to remove noise, boilerplate, and repetitive lines.
Returns distilled summary without conversational filler.

title: Chunked Map-Reduce Summarization
description: The system shall partition content exceeding chunk_chars on line boundaries, generate intermediate chunk summaries, and synthesize the result into a unified report.
acceptance_criteria: Executes single-pass extraction when content length <= chunk_chars.
Partitions content into line-delimited chunks when content length > chunk_chars.
Synthesizes intermediate chunk summaries into unified final report.
Maintains order and avoids chunk boundary truncation.

title: Strict Structured JSON Extraction
description: The system shall extract structured data matching a target schema from unstructured input using temperature <= 0.1 and strict JSON output constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Instructs model to output only valid JSON without external markdown commentary.
Applies low temperature (0.1) for deterministic schema conformity.

title: Model Inventory & Status Enumeration
description: The system shall query the Ollama /api/tags endpoint and return a human-readable inventory of models including parameter size, quantization level, file size in GB, and active default model.
acceptance_criteria: Parses /api/tags JSON response and calculates size in gigabytes rounded to 2 decimals.
Formats each model with name, parameter count, quantization, and disk size.
Indicates currently active default model.
Returns graceful error message if Ollama is unreachable.

title: Memory Pre-warming & Keep-Alive
description: The system shall issue a keep_alive = -1 request to the Ollama endpoint to pin the specified model in memory and eliminate cold-start latency.
acceptance_criteria: Sends payload with model and keep_alive: -1 to /api/generate.
Returns success message on HTTP 200.
Returns error string on network or HTTP failure.

title: MCP Protocol STDIO Cleanliness & Isolation
description: The system shall communicate strictly via JSON-RPC 2.0 over standard I/O (STDIO) transport, routing all internal logging, warnings, and diagnostic telemetry exclusively to stderr.
acceptance_criteria: Stdout stream contains only valid JSON-RPC 2.0 messages.
Stderr stream handles all log output without polluting stdout.
Responds to initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, and tools/call.
